title: A generic stack
description:
Write `Stack<T>`, storing its elements in a `std::vector<T>`.

| Member | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `void push(T value)` | adds to the top |
| `bool pop()` | removes the top; returns `false` if the stack was empty |
| `const T& top() const` | the top element (only called when not empty) |
| `bool empty() const`, `std::size_t size() const` | |

Define `push` **outside** the class body, to practise the syntax: `template <typename T> void Stack<T>::push(T value) { ... }`
